about: Generated release 0 of the Tribes of Behavior atlas (ADR-0003 §10). Hand-authored before the database existed; import_atlas loads it as release 0, after which the database is the truth and export_atlas regenerates these files. Do not hand-edit after import.

sources.title: Tribes of Behavior — Iberia sketch
sources.note: Hand-drawn from general histories of Iberia. Every keyframe is an estimate; dates are ± a generation.

sources.title: Tribes of Behavior — Maghreb sketch
sources.note: Written from general histories held in the model's memory, not from cited works. Every keyframe is an estimate to be replaced by sourced ones.

sources.title: Tribes of Behavior — world media & channels sketch
sources.note: Coarse continental spreads of each medium and a handful of landmark routes and cables; dates from memory.
